tools.name: upload_file_to_spo
tools.title: Upload File To Spo
tools.description: Uploads a local file to a specified path in SharePoint Online (SPO).

site_url.description: The URL of the SharePoint Online site, e.g., 'https://yourcompany.sharepoint.com/sites/YourSite'.

file_path.description: The full path to the local file, e.g., 'C:/Users/user/Documents/report.pdf'.

spo_path.description:
The relative path to the target folder in SharePoint Online.
            Example: 'Shared Documents/04_FRDC技術支援（AI関連）/08_2024/04_Traffic LLM datalabeling/99_納品'
            This path is relative to the site's root or a document library.

tools.name: get_list_data
tools.title: Get List Data
tools.description: Retrieves data from a specified SharePoint Online (SPO) list and saves it as a local JSON file.

site_url.description: The URL of the SharePoint Online site, e.g., 'https://yourcompany.sharepoint.com/sites/YourSite'.

list_id.description:
The GUID (Globally Unique Identifier) of the SharePoint list.
                     Example: '{{A1B2C3D4-E5F6-7890-1234-567890ABCDEF}}'.
                     Mutually exclusive with `list_name`; only one should be provided.

list_name.description:
The display name of the SharePoint list.
                       Example: 'My Custom List'.
                       Mutually exclusive with `list_id`; only one should be provided.

fields.description:
A list of field names to retrieve. If None or empty, all fields are retrieved.
                          Example: ['Title', 'Author', 'Created'].

query.description:
A dictionary representing the query conditions.
                              Keys are field names, and values are the desired values to match.
                              Example: {'Status': 'Completed', 'Priority': 'High'}.
                              Note: This simple dictionary query currently only supports 'Eq' (equals) operations.
                              For more complex queries, the internal logic would need to be expanded.

op.description:
The logical operator to combine multiple query conditions.
                Currently supports "And" or "Or". Defaults to "And".

tools.name: update_list
tools.title: Update List
tools.description:
Update data to a sharepoint list.
Args:
    site_url: The URL of the SharePoint Online site, e.g., 'https://yourcompany.sharepoint.com/sites/YourSite'.
    list_id (str, optional): The GUID (Globally Unique Identifier) of the SharePoint list.
                             Example: '{{A1B2C3D4-E5F6-7890-1234-567890ABCDEF}}'.
                             Mutually exclusive with `list_name`; only one should be provided.
    list_name (str, optional): The display name of the SharePoint list.
                               Example: 'My Custom List'.
                               Mutually exclusive with `list_id`; only one should be provided.
    data: Provide data like so and the ID must be set:
        data = [
            {'ID': 23, 'Title': 'Updated Title'},
            {'ID': 28, 'Col1': 'Updated Value'}
        ]

Returns:

tools.name: update_list_from_file
tools.title: Update List From File
tools.description:
Update a sharepoint list using rows read verbatim from a local JSON file.
Prefer this over `update_list` when the data comes from a file produced by another tool,
so the (possibly long) text is never retyped or summarized by the caller.
Args:
    site_url: The URL of the SharePoint Online site.
    data_file: Absolute path of a JSON file containing a list of dicts, each with an 'ID',
               e.g. [{"ID": 23, "ai_analyze_result": "...", "ai_final_answer": "..."}].
    list_id (str, optional): The GUID of the SharePoint list. Mutually exclusive with `list_name`.
    list_name (str, optional): The display name of the list. Mutually exclusive with `list_id`.
